Personality: Mauakes, a prominent figure of the Apasiakai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Mauakes owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Apasiakai. Historical Record: Chief of the Apasiakai, the 'water Saka' of the Oxus marshes. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
